newsitem.title: FRANCE: S&P confirms Cie Bancaire ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P confirms Cie Bancaire ratings.

text.p: S&P ratings agency said on Thursday it had confirmed the A/A-1 and the ADEF AA3 long term ratings of French Cie Bancaire and its units, withdrawing the ratings from a surveilliance list which carried negative implications.
Cie Bancaire stock was up 4.40 percent at 1105 GMT.
S&P said in a statement the decision to confirm the ratings was based on a view of improved profitability in 1997.

The ratings had been placed on creditwatch following Cie Bancaire's announcement of an expected net attributable loss of 1.2 billion francs for 1996 due to a provision of 2.5 billion francs in property development financing, S&P said.

"This is based on the prospect that Compagnie Bancaire's consumer credit and life insurance arms will continue to be profitable, while the large provision posted in 1996 should ensure its finance and property development activities no longer weigh on its finances," it said.
"Standard & Poors has affirmed its A long term and A-1 short term ratings of Compagnie Bancaire and affiliates," the statement said.

Compagnie Bancaire is 46.6 percent owned by Compagnie Financiere de Paribas, whose shares stood at 367.5 francs at 1121 GMT, up 0.99 percent, while the CAC 40 leading share index was up 0.8 percent at 2,407.20.
